stem: Which decimal is the same as 7/10?
hints: Look at the bottom number. A bottom of 10 means the whole is cut into tenths.
7/10 is read "7 tenths". Tenths go in the first place after the decimal point.
Write 0, then the decimal point, then put the 7 in the first place after the point.

solution.methodName: Say it as tenths or hundredths, then write it

steps.why: A bottom number of 10 means tenths. A bottom number of 100 means hundredths.

steps.action: Put the 7 in the first place after the decimal point.
steps.why: The first place after the point is the tenths place.
7/10 is less than 1 whole, so there are no whole numbers. We write 0 there.

trapNotes.7.10: This copies the two numbers of the fraction with a point between them. The decimal point does not replace the fraction bar.
trapNotes.0.07: This is 7 hundredths (7/100). The 7 is one place too far to the right.
trapNotes.7.0: This is 7 wholes. 7/10 is less than 1 whole.
